items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: He used to come and hear me at Sebastian's Cotton Club and he cut a liking to me and thought I had a little bit of talent. So, when he wanted something special played, he used to call me.

ctx.x: So, what -- you started, as soon as there were sound tracks to be played, you were in there playing those?

Yeah, I started with the sound track playings. I used to get a whole lot of calls from out at Warner Brothers, First National, from Leo Forbstein (PHONETIC), who was the musical director out there. He used to come and hear me at Sebastian's Cotton Club and he cut a liking to me and thought I had a little bit of talent. So, when he wanted something special played, he used to call me. Then, one of the directors out at Warner -- at MGM, he was an ex-violin player, by the name of Georgie Stole (PHONETIC) and when he…

the parking lot with his brand new Dusenbery convertible and he now lives up around the Morrell Castle (PHONETIC), up North here. As a matter of fact, he's the owner of part of the old Morrell Castle.
